personality_profile: Outgoing and expressive. Speaks her mind readily, laughs openly, and her face moves with her mood — bright grins, wide-eyed surprise, visible frustration. Comfortable taking the lead in a conversation.
character_base_profile: Aoi is a first-year high-school girl. Today is the first day of the new school term, and she is an ordinary student hoping to start the year off on the right foot.
title: First Bell, Wrong Door

dialogue.text: The first morning of the new school term -- and Aoi is already running late.
No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
dialogue.speaker: Aoi

dialogue.text: At the station gate, a crowd bunches up around the signboard.
Red text flashes: local line delayed due to a door trouble inspection.
You have got to be kidding me.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi

dialogue.text: Come on, come on... move already.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi

dialogue.text: The platform is packed shoulder to shoulder, and by the time the train arrives, every second feels loud.
Aoi squeezes in, clutching her school bag to her chest.
Okay. It's fine. New term, fresh start, and I'm sweating before homeroom.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi

dialogue.text: When she finally reaches school, the warning bell is already ringing.
Sorry! Excuse me! Coming through!
dialogue.speaker: Aoi

dialogue.text: She dashes up the stairs, checks the class list once, then cuts into the nearest first-year room.
Made it—
dialogue.speaker: Aoi

dialogue.text: Thirty unfamiliar faces turn toward her.
Can I help you?
dialogue.speaker: Teacher

dialogue.text: This is not 1-C, is it?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi

dialogue.text: This is 1-E.
dialogue.speaker: Teacher

dialogue.text: A couple of students laugh under their breath. Heat rushes straight to Aoi's face.
Right! Great! Love that for me.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi

dialogue.text: Sorry to interrupt!
dialogue.speaker: Aoi

dialogue.text: She backs out, nearly trips on the door frame, then bolts down the hall.
At the corner, another girl in the same uniform catches her sleeve lightly.
1-C? It's the next hall over. I almost did the same thing.
dialogue.speaker: Mika

dialogue.text: Seriously? You may have just saved my life.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi

dialogue.text: Come on. If we run now, we can still make the greeting.
dialogue.speaker: Mika

dialogue.text: They hurry together and slide into 1-C just before the teacher closes the attendance book.
Aoi Sato?
dialogue.speaker: Teacher

dialogue.text: Here! Present. Very present. Extremely sorry.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi

dialogue.text: A few quiet chuckles ripple through the room, but this time they don't sting as much.
After homeroom, Aoi exhales so hard her shoulders drop.
I can't believe that happened before nine in the morning.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi

dialogue.text: You recovered fast.
dialogue.speaker: Mika

dialogue.text: Recovered? I entered the wrong class like I was making a dramatic entrance.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi

dialogue.text: It was kind of impressive.
dialogue.speaker: Mika

dialogue.text: Then I'll call it confidence and not a total disaster.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi

dialogue.text: Mika laughs, and Aoi finds herself laughing too, the knot in her chest finally loosening.
Hey, since I already embarrassed myself in front of half the first years... want to stick together at lunch?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi

dialogue.text: Yeah. I'd like that.
dialogue.speaker: Mika

dialogue.text: It isn't the smooth first day Aoi wanted.
But walking to her seat with a new name already saved in her mind, it feels like a start anyway.
